rule: verify.sh fails a check only if its violation_count increases beyond this baseline. A check with status "blocked" has no numeric baseline yet — that is not the same as 0 violations, and must never be treated as passing. Its first real baseline is set the run it first executes successfully, which requires a human gate per Section 11's 'lowering the bar requires a human gate' — recording an initial baseline is the same kind of event.
